question: Space Question #200: Has anyone died in outer space?
short_answer: Three Soviet cosmonauts died above 100 km when Soyuz 11 depressurized in 1971. This is a critical research focus in spaceflight science and astronomy.
full_explanation: Detailed scientific analysis of question #200: Space agencies (including NASA, ESA, JAXA) investigate death in space to advance deep space exploration, technological innovation, and orbital safety protocols.
